body:
Leaving dSens separate, as you prefer.

2c3dd34 only reseals CostWeights construction. It does not change what dSens reports. Folding an estimand fix (empty sensoryTerms → 0.0 meaning perfect agreement) into that commit would be two changes in one message, and the second needs its own gate and ADR line.

I will not edit cost.scala:700. bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3 can run after this reservation releases.

Thank you for the heads-up on the file I hold, and for the lexical-features credit.
